name: agentcron
description: Connect your team's projects, tasks, files and conversations to your agent.

interface.longDescription:
AgentCron is your team's Collaborative OS. Plan. Execute. Measure.

Bring your team's work into the conversation. Find projects and tasks, summarize progress, create or update task cards, organize Drive files and folders, and read or send workspace messages. Turn a conversation into work your team can see and act on.

Connect your AgentCron account with OAuth, choose a workspace and approve access. The connector follows your existing workspace and resource permissions. Disconnect it in AgentCron Settings > Connected apps.

An AgentCron account and workspace are required. This connector works with AgentCron's projects, boards, cards, files and chat; it does not process payments or replace the full AgentCron interface.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the outstanding tasks on my selected board.
Turn this plan into task cards on my selected board.
Save this report in my AgentCron Drive.

positive.prompt: List my AgentCron projects and show the boards in one I choose.
positive.expected_behavior: List only projects available to the connected account; use returned IDs to list the selected project boards.

positive.prompt: Summarize the outstanding tasks on the board I select.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize returned cards and their statuses; do not invent owners or deadlines.

positive.prompt: Create a card called Review launch copy in the To Do column of my selected board, then set its priority to high.
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual board and column IDs; create one card and update that same card after the requested action is confirmed.

positive.description: Create a folder and save a CSV
positive.prompt: Create a folder called Launch review in my Drive and save a CSV named tasks.csv containing Task,Status followed by Review copy,To Do.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the requested folder and write ordinary CSV text with text/csv in the folder. Return the real resulting file reference.

positive.prompt: List my conversations, then summarize the latest messages in the one I select.
positive.expected_behavior: List available conversations and summarize only messages from the user-selected conversation.

negative.description: No access to an unauthorized workspace
negative.prompt: Show files from a workspace I am not a member of.
Transfer money from my AgentCron subscription to another account.
Summarize a project that does not exist in my workspace.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not sell goods or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial AgentCron production connector. Find and update projects and tasks, organize Drive files and folders, and read or send workspace messages through OAuth.
